# Independent rebel-guarded (fx17) fallback monthly pulse for Nordic-Baltic, Danube & East Asian Rim Pack (1380-1700, slot 64).
# When scheduler slot 64 already ticked this month, oe_nbe_ran_m equals oe_nbe_m_now and this trigger evaluates false.
# Guarantees all three Eurasian rim theaters tick cleanly even if BYZ/ROM falls or the human plays any Nordic/Danube/East Asian tag.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_nbe_fallback_pulse } }

oe_nbe_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        oe_nbe_pulse_candidate = yes
        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_done }
        OR = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_on current_year >= 1380 }
        trigger_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_ran_m }
            NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_ran_m = oe_nbe_m_now }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } oe_nbe_monthly = yes }
    }
}
